**Reasoning**

- Each person eats \(0.2\) kg of rice per meal.  
- They eat rice at lunch and dinner, i.e., 2 meals per day.  
- Daily consumption per person: \(0.2\text{ kg} \times 2 = 0.4\text{ kg}\).  
- There are 5 members, so household daily consumption: \(0.4\text{ kg} \times 5 = 2\text{ kg}\).  
- A 42 kg bag will therefore last \(42\text{ kg} \div 2\text{ kg/day} = 21\) days.  
- Converting days to weeks: \(21\text{ days} \div 7\text{ days/week} = 3\) weeks.

All peer calculations match this reasoning.

**Final answer:**  
Final answer: 3
